title: RRFC: Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning for Iterative Image-to-Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conditional image-to-image generators are single-shot: they map input features to an output in one forward pass and treat it as final, with no opportunity to improve on it. Although trained to produce the best possible result in one step, such a model leaves room for improvement if it can adaptively revise its own output over iterations. We propose Recursive Refinement via Feedback Conditioning (RRFC), a novel feedback-conditioning framework for iterative output refinement that teaches a model to adaptively revise its output by conditioning on a new signal, namely its most recent previous prediction, which is fed back as an auxiliary set of channels alongside the original input. This preserves the generator's core architecture while modifying its conditioning interface and, depending on the model family, its training or inference procedure, so RRFC can be attached to existing generators without redesign. translated_title: RRFC：基于反馈条件化的递归细化用于迭代图像到图像生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15694v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：条件图像到图像生成器是单次性的：它们在前向传播中将输入特征映射为输出，并将其视为最终结果，没有改进的机会。尽管经过训练以在一步中产生最佳结果，但如果模型能在迭代过程中自适应地修正其输出，仍有改进空间。我们提出了递归细化通过反馈条件化（RRFC），一种新颖的反馈条件化框架，用于迭代输出细化，它通过条件化一个新信号（即最近的先前预测）来教会模型自适应地修正其输出，该信号作为辅助通道集与原始输入一起反馈。这保留了生成器的核心架构，同时修改其条件化接口，并根据模型家族的不同，修改其训练或推理过程，因此RRFC可以附加到现有生成器而无需重新设计。我们在六个基线上评估了RRFC。
tldr: RRFC通过将生成器自身最近的输出作为额外输入反馈，实现迭代式自适应修正，从而在不改变核心架构的情况下提升图像到图像生成质量。
en_tdlr: RRFC enhances image-to-image generation by feeding the generator's latest output back as auxiliary input, enabling iterative self-correction without architectural redesign.
